name: Resident Card, Student/Pupil Category (Carte de Resident)

requirements.blocker_text: Enrollment receipt or student card from a recognized institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to a recognized Ivorian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Mandatory online pre-enrollment through ONECI's system, plus an online sponsorship (parrainage) form.

outcome.duration_length: requires periodic renewal; exact validity period not confirmed in sources fetched

sources.title: ONECI (Office National de l'Etat Civil et de l'Identification, Cote d'Ivoire) -- carte de resident, student/pupil category among listed categories: mandatory online pre-enrollment and sponsorship form, residence certificate under 6 months old, category-specific proof (enrollment receipt/student card); fee 300,000 FCFA (non-ECOWAS) / 150,000 FCFA (French nationals) / 35,000 FCFA (religious personnel, French cooperants -- students not explicitly listed in the reduced-fee tier)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Cote d'Ivoire). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 ONECI sourced, but thin: ONECI's page lists 'students and pupils' as one of several carte-de-resident categories without a category-specific fee or duration distinct from the general 300,000/150,000/35,000 FCFA tiers (which appear to key off nationality/professional category rather than purpose of stay) -- whether students pay the full 300,000 FCFA non-ECOWAS rate or a reduced student rate was not confirmed and is disclosed as a gap. Cote d'Ivoire does not appear to operate a separate 'student visa' distinct from the general resident-card system used for all long-stay foreigners -- unlike many countries in this dataset with a dedicated student-visa instrument, structurally this is one unified card with category-specific supporting documents. work_rights set to 'none' as a conservative default since no student work-rights provision was found in the fetched source.
